questions.text: 10% APR compounded daily gives approximately what APY?
What is the biggest red flag for a high-APY farm?
options: The yield comes from token emissions while the reward token price is dropping

questions.text: What is the goal of delta-neutral farming?
options: Eliminate price risk and earn only fees and funding

questions.text: When calculating net yield from LP farming, what must you subtract from the headline APY?
options: Impermanent loss, gas costs, and smart contract risk premium
Nothing — APY is the final number

questions.text: What is the difference between real yield and emission yield?
options: Real yield comes from protocol fees; emission yield comes from token inflation

questions.text: 100% APR compounded daily for 1 year. $1,000 invested becomes approximately:
A farm advertises 800% APY. The reward token has dropped 95% in 3 months. You're considering depositing $5,000. What's the smart move?
options: Skip it — emission yield without sustainable demand is a guaranteed loss
Deposit and immediately sell rewards every hour
Deposit only if you can leverage 5x
